_doc: Hard Breach Charge (attacker pool; research/gadgets.md §3.2). Placed on any breakable surface, reinforced ones included, in 2 s; its fuse runs 4 s from then (not remote, Y7S3). Two each (Y6S3.3). Its reach and size are placeholders. Its blast: 5 hp to anyone within about 0.5 m (Fandom); it cuts its square, steel too. Whether a bullet destroys it is a placeholder (yes).
name: Hard Breach Charge
